title: Exercise Git-backed incoming evidence application through its public step
outcome: Exercise Git-backed incoming evidence application through its public step
acceptance: A meaningful real Git/two-store fixture captures native evidence, stages and commits its packs on the dedicated data branch, fetches and retains the selected commit on the receiver, and calls the composed apply_evidence_exchange or public apply_evidence step.

The regression proves original canonical IDs and bytes are retained without native feed, verification or claim credit, exact completed replay succeeds with Git and pack files unavailable, and malformed or conflicting packs record the original terminal outcome identities.

Run the regression on the supported confined-execution platform using actual implementation paths; do not substitute a hand-built InspectedEvidence or pack copying alone for the composed receive path.
